findings.source_section: Invocation and record-first evidence; Authority and applicable evidence
findings.related_sections: Investigation Guideline 11/14 (evidence classification and required Evidence field/facts); Traceability 30.1 (usable durable evidence/record integrity); exact IGV qualification payload
findings.issue: The current canonical Investigation report leaves {evrel}, {ev[bytes]} and {ev[sha256]} as literal unexpanded template markers in its evidence metadata. Its correction explanation renders the original and attributed alternatives identically as ?7/?8, obscuring the exact correction distinction. Sixteen questionmark-bearing lines also degrade section-sign, quote and separator presentation.
findings.evidence: Actual strict UTF-8 bytes contain the markers and identical alternatives; bound original approval retains U+003F, approved/applied qualification has U+00A7 at offsets 27/42. The evidence/result hashes bind authentic defective report bytes, not corrected rendered fields.
findings.impact: Limited documentation/traceability impact: a reader cannot use that evidence metadata or that sentence alone to identify/understand the exact correction. All fourteen required report fields remain identifiable, actual evidence path is stated later and result binds actual report/evidence/ledger. Independent checks are executable; not wholesale report invalidity or a missing-evidence CANNOT COMPLETE.
findings.recommended_resolution: Route this new finding through separately initiated Finding Investigation and Corrective Change Decision. If a correction is approved, use exact append-only linked qualification/revision by authorized actor, preserve originals and actual hash links, then applicable independent assurance/full Audit. Do not edit old records or reapply P1-P5 merely to cure presentation.
findings.human_decision_reason: Human chooses/initiates any next governed stage; an exact approved other-actor-record correction route is required before publication. This Audit neither investigates nor approves/applies it.
